description: Curated historical screenshots documenting the development evolution of the Podium EDS chassis.

milestones.name: Initial EDS Blockout
milestones.summary: Initial primitive blockout establishing baseline hardpoints: 5.050 m length, 2.000 m width, 3.600 m wheelbase, and neutral ground plane placement.

images.description: Front 3/4 perspective comparison showing basic vehicle proportions against comparison chassis.
Side elevation verifying wheelbase (3.60 m) and overall vehicle length (5.05 m).
Plan view confirming maximum width (2.00 m) and basic planform envelope.

milestones.name: Early Aerodynamic Revisions
milestones.summary: Parametric lofting and early aerodynamic revisions focusing on surface continuity between sidepods, floor undercuts, and halo fairing integration.

images.description: Full-body front 3/4 render demonstrating lofted bodywork continuity.
Side view highlighting continuous engine cowl curvature and sidepod slope.
Detailed inspection of sidepod undercut transition into the floor edge.

milestones.name: Blender Clay Refinement
milestones.summary: Transition from procedural Three.js meshes to professional Blender authoring with sculpted clay bodywork, rounded-D sidepod inlets, and twin-channel diffuser profiles.

images.description: Blender clay render showing full car curvature with sculpted front wing and sidepods.
Orthographic side clay render exhibiting aerodynamic rake and nose slope.
Underside view showing twin-channel venturi diffuser geometry and rear strakes.

milestones.name: Rejected Visual Design Concepts
milestones.summary: Three radical visual design concepts (Aero Predator, Hyper Aero, Precision Machine) exploring aggressive aesthetics; rejected for disproportionate visual weight and toy-like styling.

images.description: Concept A (Aero Predator): aggressive angular sidepods, rejected as non-cohesive.
Concept B (Hyper Aero): extreme downforce styling, rejected for unharmonious proportions.
Concept C (Precision Machine): technical aerodynamic styling, rejected as overly boxy.

milestones.name: Cockpit and Nose Experiments
milestones.summary: Focused studies investigating cockpit opening dimensions, halo fairing attachment, and nose taper variants (N20 and N30).

images.description: N20 variant close-up showing refined halo transition into the cockpit surround.
N20 variant front monocoque close-up showing nose cone curvature.
N30 variant showing front pushrod suspension pick-up points on the nose bulkhead.

milestones.name: C42-Referenced D1 Reconstruction
milestones.summary: Active authoring baseline: original EDS-G03 chassis reconstruction referencing C42 proportion and visual presence benchmarks while authoring 100% original geometry (141,768 triangles, 11 draw calls).

images.description: Matched comparison sheet: C42 benchmark (left) vs EDS-G03 D1 original chassis (right).
Clean clay render of EDS-G03 D1 showing fully resolved single-seater proportions.
Cockpit matched comparison sheet: C42 reference (left) vs EDS-G03 D1 cockpit (right).
